title: Democracia y memoria
goal: Read a closing comparison of how Argentina, Chile, and Uruguay each confronted their dictatorships' legacies differently -- early trials, truth commissions (Rettig, Valech), and Uruguay's unique amnesty-by-referendum pattern.

items: Contrast Argentina's and Chile's initial approaches to justice.
State what the Rettig and Valech Commissions documented.
Describe Uruguay's Ley de Caducidad and its 1989/2009 referendums.
Explain what Uruguay's Supreme Court ruled in 2011.
Use en tanto que to contrast or frame a comparison.
